notes.title: Major Update : Enhanced Aiming and Movement Controls
notes.notes:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45147202/64519560c6310774c6527f37843c3398bbf0b1ab.gif"]



I've implemented significant improvements to character controls and punching mechanics based on your FEEDBACK! 

Intuitive Powerful Punch Charging: 

- Take your time charging your devastating powerful punch with precision as the timer has been removed. Now you can hold the powerful punch button to charge the punch while aiming until you release the button to throw the punch. 

- The punch power will be adjusted based on your aim. 

- The new visual trajectory line and the rock give you a clear preview of your punching and picking up actions, letting you aim with deadly accuracy and pick up objects precisely.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45147202/2f92a923d1defd7561976ce83b89f5930331cafd.png"]
